description: Header file declaring bit manipulation functions for packing and unpacking bits, including operations on bit buffers and spans, within the ocudu::ocuduvec namespace.

methods.name: bit_unpack
methods.description: Unpacks an unsigned integer value into bits, mapping bits from value to a span of uint8_t.

methods.name: bit_unpack
methods.description: Unpacks a bit buffer into bits, with optional offset.

methods.name: bit_pack
methods.description: Packs bits from a span into an unsigned integer, with a limit of 32 bits.

methods.name: bit_pack
methods.description: Packs bits from a span into an unsigned integer, with the number of bits equal to span size.

methods.name: bit_pack
methods.description: Packs bits from a span into a bit_buffer.

methods.name: bit_pack
methods.description: Packs bits from a span into a bit_buffer with an offset.

methods.name: copy_offset
methods.description: Copies bits from input buffer to output buffer starting at specified positions, for a given number of bits.
